messages:
Marcus L: Hi team — my new physical insurance card arrived but with my old apartment address (moved last month). It has my full name and DOB. Worried about privacy and identity theft. Can we stop future mailings or reissue ASAP?

Priya (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, Marcus. Do you have the old card pic? Also confirm you updated your home address in AD/payroll and the benefits portal — sometimes carrier uses the old address on file.

Marcus L: I updated AD and payroll on 2026-02-10. I didn't touch the carrier portal. I uploaded a photo of the card here. Postal tracking shows "delivered" yesterday.

Lisa - Benefits: Thanks for flagging. Short checklist: 1) We can request an immediate reissue with the correct address; carrier turnaround for a new physical card is usually 7-10 business days. 2) We can ask the carrier to cancel any future shipments / flag the member record for "do not mail" to avoid another wrong mailing. 3) We can generate a company-signed temporary coverage letter and point you to the carrier's digital ID (e-card) you can download now.

Marcus L: Prefer the fastest privacy fix. Is there anything we can do about the card that was delivered? USPS says they delivered to "front door." Can Mailroom hold or recover?

Mailroom: We only handle internal company mail. If USPS delivered to your home address, we can't intercept. If you suspect fraud, file a USPS claim and also consider credit freeze / fraud alert. We can help draft a notice to your landlord if needed.

Lisa - Benefits: Step action: email benefits@redwood.com with subject EXACT: "CARD ADDRESS MISMATCH - Marcus L - ATTENTION" and attach a photo of the incorrect card plus a copy of a government ID or utility bill showing your current address. We'll: (A) create ticket and request expedited e-card access, (B) submit carrier change-of-address and reissue request, (C) ask carrier to suppress further physical mailings. If you want, we can also request the carrier to mark the delivered card as "void" in their system.

BenefitsBot: \u2705 Ticket created: #BEN-4721 "Card address mismatch / reissue request". Assigned to Lisa. Expected carrier response 2 business days for suppression, 7-10 business days for reissue. If you uploaded docs, confirm receipt here.

Marcus L: Sent email with attachments. Also, can the company letter include a note that the delivered card has wrong address so clinic/billing teams don't use it? Had a lab appointment next week.

Priya (People Ops): Yes — we can issue a temporary coverage & ID confirmation letter on company letterhead that lists your member ID and correct address but omits SSN. That should work at clinics. We'll mark it urgent for appointments.

Lisa - Benefits: Uploaded the temporary letter to the ticket and enabled carrier e-card access (you should get an SMS/email from the carrier with instructions). Also requested suppression of physical mailings. If the carrier asks for additional docs, I'll DM you.

Marcus L: Got the letter, and e-card email popped in. Thanks everyone. Also filing a USPS claim now. Appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:
